usage: ladon proof-search [-h]
                          {proof,index,evidence,search,explain,discover,consumers,constructor,goal,check}
                          ...

Build and query local Lean proof-navigation evidence.

positional arguments:
  {proof,index,evidence,search,explain,discover,consumers,constructor,goal,check}
    proof               Extract source-bound elaborated proof applications.
    index               Build, inspect, or query the persistent local index.
    evidence            Query stored ProofIR evidence.
    search              Run the versioned name-search contract.
    explain             Compare one indexed candidate type with a goal
                        (structural evidence only).
    discover            Check a bounded candidate set against one exact goal.
    consumers           Find bounded declaration consumers.
    constructor         Inspect bounded constructor field coverage.
    goal                Capture a source goal or query compiler text.
    check               Run an explicit bounded Lean checker operation.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
